A short guide What is autism? A different way of sensing, thinking and connecting.
The basics A lifelong difference in how the brain develops. It’s not an illness. It isn’t caused by vaccines or by parenting.
A spectrum isn’t a line It’s a mix, different for everyone. Social communication Senses Routines Deep interests Processing time Movement
Senses The volume can be turned up. Or down. Everyday noise can feel painful, or pain can barely register. Noise Bright light Clothing labels Crowds Smells
Masking Hiding autistic traits to fit in. Many autistic people, especially women and girls, do it for years. It’s exhausting and can lead to burnout.
Often comes with company ADHD, anxiety, sleep and gut troubles These are common alongside autism, and they can be treated.
What helps Support, not a cure. Understanding Sensory tweaks Predictable plans Clear, direct talk Rest & recovery OT, speech or psych Community
The goal A world that fits more brains. Honesty, focus and deep knowledge are real strengths. Many adults are only now being diagnosed, and that’s okay.
